info.title: Restaurant API Documentation
info.description: This is the API documentation for the server built with Laravel. It describes the endpoints used to manage dishes.

post.description: Creates a new user account and returns the user's data.

email: The email has already been taken.
password: The password must be at least 8 characters.

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns an access token and refresh token. The refresh token is also set as an HttpOnly cookie.
Uses the refresh token (sent via an HttpOnly cookie) to generate a new pair of access and refresh tokens.
Invalidates the user's current token and clears the refresh token cookie.

get.description: Returns the data of the currently authenticated user.

post.description: Updates the profile information of the currently authenticated user. To upload an avatar, use `multipart/form-data`.

email: The email has already been taken.
avatar: The avatar must be an image.
